reason: An interactive chat UI plugin that uses a fast whip-flick gesture to submit a fixed "go work!" message to the active agent while preserving and restoring the user's draft.

summaries.zh: 在聊天编辑器中提供可甩动的交互式皮鞭，达到速度阈值时向当前智能体发送固定的“go work!”消息并恢复原有草稿。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive whip to the chat composer that submits a fixed "go work!" message to the active agent when flicked past a speed threshold, then restores the original draft.

capabilities: Adds a fixed interactive SVG whip overlay to the chat composer
Tracks pointer movement and calculates release speed
Replaces the current draft with "go work!" and submits it when the release speed exceeds 2.0 px/ms
Restores the previously saved draft after submission
